name: cph-pi
description: 基于 Pi 极简防臃肿基座的 Microsoft Copilot 自主编程 Agent Harness

scripts.build: bun run build:package && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.web:node: bun run build:package && node package/bin/cph-pi.js web
scripts.build:package: bun build src/cli.ts --target node --outfile package/bin/cph-pi.js && bun build scripts/probe-agent-access.ts --target node --outfile package/bin/check-accounts.js
